stem.text: The skeletal formulas of two compounds are shown.

stem.label: progesterone
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of progesterone: steroid skeleton with a C=O on ring A, a C=C in ring A, and an acetyl group (C=O) on ring D.

stem.label: testosterone
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of testosterone: steroid skeleton with a C=O on ring A, a C=C in ring A, and an OH group on ring D.

stem.text: Which statements about progesterone and testosterone are correct?

A.text: They both contain a ketone group, and they both have geometrical isomers due to the $\text{C=C}$ bond.

B.text: They have the same molecular formula, and they both have geometrical isomers.

C.text: They have the same number of chiral carbons, and they have the same molecular formula.

D.text: They have the same number of chiral carbons, and they both contain a ketone group.
